title: Red Hat Security Advisory: postgresql:16 security update
description: A security vulnerability (CVE-2026-103484) in the pgvector extension of PostgreSQL allows arbitrary code execution via an out-of-bounds write during the IVFFlat index build process. This issue affects PostgreSQL 16 as packaged for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.6 Extended Update Support. Red Hat has issued an important security update to address this flaw.
